title: 航空機の原理
subtitle: Principle of Aircraft
keywords: Principles of flight 2.Aircraft structure 3.Aviation materials 4.Jet engines 5.Practical training
educationalGoal: An aircraft and its components are designed by combining knowledge of engineering fields such as aerodynamics, structure, engine and control. In order to begin studying in specialized fields, it is important to know the relationship between what is learned in each field and the aircraft. In this course, students will learn how the mechanical elements of aircraft relate to mechanisms and principles through lectures and practical training.
advice: This is a basic aviation systems course. We will cover the following materials: 1. Ae1.rodynamics of airplanes 2. Principles of flight 3. Aircraft structure 4. Jet engines 5. Aviation materials 6. Practical training Students are asked to complete assignments and create presentations related to the subject of aviation. Students should participate actively in the class. Students should not be absent from the class as important handouts may not be received.
requiredKnowledge: This is an introductory course in the curriculum of the department of aviation. The class consists of lectures and practical training. Students are required to work actively on reports and quizzes.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the principles of aviation, flight, and lift generation.
Be able to explain different kinds of aircraft materials and their mechanical properties.
Be able to explain different kinds of aircraft engines and their components.
Be able to broadly understand specialty subjects through lectures and practical training
Be able to disassemble and reassemble devices through an understanding their constructions.
Be able to create reports through practical training.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Explain the characteristics of aircraft as transport machines. (2) Explain briefly the principles of flight. (3) Explain the materials and structures of aircraft. (4) Explain briefly the types and components of jet engine. (5) Name the specialty subjects in aviation and explain their interconnections. (6) Disassemble and reassemble machine parts using tools and machine structures. (7) Report on the training using figures and photographs.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain the characteristics of aircraft as transport machines. (2) Explain briefly the principles of flight. (3) Explain the materials and structures of aircraft. (4) Describe the types of jet engines. (5) Name the specialty subjects in aviation. (6) Disassemble and reassemble machine parts using tools. (7) Report on the training.

lessons.content: [Lecture] Learn about the evolution of the shapes of aircraft throughout the history of aviation. Learn about flight principles and stability.
lessons.assignments: Read chapters 1 to 4 of the textbook

lessons.content: [Lecture] Learn about aircraft engines and aircraft materials and structures
lessons.assignments: Read chapters 5 and 6 of the textbook

lessons.content: [Integrated learning 1] Work on exercises and discuss aircraft. Learn about Bernoulli’s theorem and the airspeed indicator.
[Practical training] Learn the mechanism of the airspeed indicator through disassembly/assembly
lessons.assignments: Review the training and create an assignment report

lessons.content: [Integrated learning 2] Work on exercises and discuss aircraft.
lessons.assignments: Read the textbook and create a presentation task

lessons.content: Test and review. Presentation of the results of the exercise.
[Integrated learning 3] Work on exercises and discuss aircraft.
lessons.assignments: Review what you have learned in this class
